description:
Create a 'chipped paint' material effect on a crate object by manually painting a wear mask.

Starting with the loaded 'SciFiCrate' object:
1. UV Unwrap the object (use Smart UV Project).
2. Create a new Image Texture named 'wear_mask' (1024x1024, Color: Black, Alpha: False).
3. Enter Texture Paint mode and paint white 'wear' details along the edges and corners of the crate.
4. IMPORTANT: Save the painted image to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/wear_mask.png' (Image > Save As).
5. Configure the object's material to mix two shaders:
   - Shader 1: Blue Base Color (Paint)
   - Shader 2: Grey/Metallic Base Color (Metal)
   - Mix Factor: Use the 'wear_mask' image texture
6. Save the project to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/distressed_crate.blend'.
